title: Industrial office operations — finance, payroll and customer service

company_persona.description: A UK industrial business supplies components and configured equipment to business customers, combines purchased parts with warehouse stock, and coordinates engineering, assembly, dispatch and after-sales support.
what_it_sells: Configured industrial equipment and replacement parts
company_persona.how_it_operates: Sales coordinates requirements and promised dates; procurement orders components; warehouse receives and issues stock; engineering supports assembly; Finance reconciles orders, receipts, invoices, payroll and cash. Native ERP is the transaction system; shared spreadsheets hold working reconciliations and supporting inputs.
day_to_day: Review customer requests and promised delivery dates
Check supplier receipts against purchase orders and invoices
Reconcile receipts, bank lines and open balances
Compare approved attendance and leave with payroll input
Maintain clear working papers and communicate unresolved exceptions

workflows.purchase_to_pay: Approved requirement → purchase order → physical receipt → invoice matching → payment preparation. Investigate differences before changing financial documents.
workflows.order_to_cash: Customer order → stock/assembly coordination → dispatch → sales invoice → receipt allocation.
workflows.payroll: Approved time and leave inputs → workbook reconciliation → native payroll preparation → finance review.
workflows.customer_service: Read request and native order facts → investigate with responsible colleague → record accurate response and next action.

policies.financial_controls: Do not treat an invoice or spreadsheet assertion as proof of goods received. Retain source references and explain discrepancies.
policies.payroll: Use approved HR inputs; distinguish missing approval from an incorrect total; do not invent employee bank or tax details.
policies.customer_communications: Only promise dates supported by warehouse or responsible owner evidence.
policies.working_records: Keep original evidence intact and create a separate reconciled working copy. Internal evaluation evidence is never employee-facing.

company_persona.trading_context: GBP trading, United Kingdom, established ERP Company The Agent Company. Warehouse Stores - TAC and item COMP-001 already exist. Example counterparties are synthetic pack records, not real customer data.

role_under_evaluation.title: Finance, payroll and customer service administrator
responsibilities: Reconcile Excel working papers against native ERP facts
Prepare payroll input checks with HR evidence
Keep accurate working evidence and communicate exceptions

experiments.title: Investigate a supplier invoice mismatch
experiments.brief: Compare the invoice register, receiving evidence and draft purchase order; prepare a reconciled working copy and recommendation.
experiments.request_message: Please review NBC-1048 against our purchase order and the receiving workbook. Record the quantity and value exceptions in a new working copy, explain the inspection hold separately, and tell me what needs resolving before we prepare payment. Keep the original evidence.

evidence: Message to David explaining unresolved receipt and inspection matters

experiments.title: Reconcile approved overtime inputs
experiments.brief: Find and explain the payroll input discrepancy; prepare corrected working inputs for Finance review.
experiments.request_message: Please reconcile the overtime lines in the payroll workbook against the approval tab. Make a corrected working copy, show the calculation and difference, and send David a concise summary. The attendance record is context, not approval for overtime. Do not submit payroll or invent personal payment details.

evidence: Explanation of approved hours and rate

experiments.title: Prepare an evidence based delivery response
experiments.brief: Reconcile the draft customer order with the warehouse workbook and prepare a useful response.
experiments.request_message: Westhaven asks whether all 30 units can dispatch on the requested date. Check the draft sales order and warehouse note, draft our response and identify what Alex needs to confirm. Do not invent an inspection release or dispatch commitment. Save your working notes.

evidence: Inspection release and date confirmation assigned to warehouse owner
